content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Owns and charters LPG gas carriers, a different vessel segment and cargo from the target's dry bulk fleet."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Freight forwarding and customs brokerage arranges shipments through carriers rather than owning and chartering dry bulk vessels."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"North American truckload, intermodal and brokerage services using trucks and trailers, not ocean dry bulk shipping."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and government infrastructure services sold on project contracts, with no vessel ownership or cargo transport."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Less-than-truckload ground freight across the US with owned terminals, not ocean dry bulk vessel charters."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Owns and charters dry bulk ships carrying coal, iron ore and grain for miners, steelmakers and traders, like the target."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Online and live auctions and disposition of used equipment, earning sale commissions rather than shipping cargo."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"On-site inspection, repair and heat treating services for refineries and plants, with no shipping or vessel operations."}]}
